nodes.title: Incoming message
nodes.caption: A customer message arrives on WhatsApp and joins the customer's existing timeline.

nodes.title: Intent identified
nodes.caption: The request is classified using the whole conversation history as context.

nodes.title: Intelligent routing
nodes.caption: Routine and within policy, so it goes to an AI agent. Anything else goes to your team.

nodes.title: AI agent
nodes.caption: The AI agent checks availability and replies on the same channel. No queue, no wait.

nodes.title: Action executed
nodes.caption: The order is updated in the connected system and the customer gets a confirmation.

nodes.title: Resolution
nodes.caption: Resolved on first contact. Sales gets a follow-up task with the full context attached.
